label: A6-EC servo tuning parameters (2000h C00.04-C00.06, 2001h C01, 2002h C02)
_source: Owner decision 2026-10-07 16:02 PDT: every A6-EC drive tuning parameter is under software control and set per joint in the machine configuration; safety bounds stay one joint-unit value for every joint. Entries transcribe the A6-EC manual (docs/drives/a6ec/A6-EC_series_servo_drive_manual.pdf chapter 7 'Gain Tuning', printed pp.140-155, and chapter 11 tables in a6ec-manual-chapter-11-parameter-list.pdf / a6ec_manual_chapter_11_parameter_list.md). The CoE subindex is the code's hexadecimal suffix plus one (C01.4E -> 0x2001:4F; chapter 11 'Index' column). Values are raw drive units: the value written is value_in_unit / scale. 'modification' records the manual's 'At stop' / 'During operation'; rt-core writes startup SDOs with the drive disabled (PREOP/SAFEOP), so both classes are satisfied. class 'tuning' may differ between joints; class 'uniform' must be one value on every axis that writes it. access 'read' is observe-only. identity 'pre_catalog' marks the three speed-feedforward keys rtctl compiled before this catalog: a machine that uses only them keeps its earlier configuration identity. Every entry is unverified on the Rosie 1430 arms: no readback on them of any C00/C01/C02 tuning value except C01.13..C01.15 exists in the repository (2026-10-07).
_unconfirmed: UNCONFIRMED items are marked per entry. Common to all: whether a startup write of an unchanged value rewrites EEPROM (C13.10 storage, ALF1.3) is not in the manual; the gain tables C01.00..C01.03 may be overridden by C00.04 = 1/2 (standard/positioning modes).

parameter_storage.manual: chapter 11 C13.10 'EtherCAT parameter storage', 0: no storage, 1: storage, default 1, modifiable during operation, effective immediately; ESI 0x2013:11 'Update function code values written via communication to EEPROM', 0..1
parameter_storage._source: One drive-wide mode, not a per-write flag: while it is 1 every parameter written over the bus is saved to EEPROM, and 607C and the HM35 result persist only with 1 (vendor notes 2026-04-15, docs/drives/a6ec/ethercat/a6ec-manufacturer-notes-2026-04-15.md item 10). STEPPERONLINE advice relayed by the owner 2026-10-09: EEPROM endurance about 1e5..1e6 writes, ALF1.3 is the too-frequent-write alarm; read back and write only on change, write commissioning trials to RAM only (C13.10 = 0) and store finalized values once.
parameter_storage._unconfirmed: Whether a write of C13.10 itself is stored, so whether a RAM-only window (0, trial writes, 1) leaves EEPROM holding 0 after a drive power cycle, is not in the manual. With verify_parameter_storage rt-core reads C13.10 at every start, writes 1 first when it differs, and refuses configuration verification until it reads 1. Bench check before relying on startup_trial: run one window, power-cycle the drive with rt-core stopped, then read C13.10 and the trial object over SDO.

forbidden.reason: C00.01 motor rotating direction (robot definition sign)
C00.07 absolute mode: derived from the robot definition's encoder_battery; power-cycle parameter
C03 instruction parameters: speed and torque limits are safety bounds, one joint-unit value for every joint
C04 I/O: DI/DO functions (S-ON, brake output)
C05 stop mode and brake timing
C06 protection: following-error, overload and overspeed thresholds are safety bounds
C07 offline inertia auto-tuning setup; the drive moves the motor itself when F30.10 starts it
C10 homing and touch probe, including the rotation gear ratio 0x2010:19/1A (robot definition) and HM35 (fixed transaction)
C13 EtherCAT parameters, including C13.10 parameter storage
F30 control actions (offline inertia auto-tuning start F30.10 moves the motor)
F31 control actions (fault, software and encoder resets)

a6ec_gain_tuning_mode._note: 0 manual (C01.00..C01.03 as written), 1 standard (gains from C00.05 stiffness level and C00.06 inertia ratio), 2 positioning.
a6ec_gain_tuning_mode._unconfirmed: UNCONFIRMED: in modes 1 and 2 the drive derives the 1st gain set from an internal table the manual does not publish; whether it then overwrites a written C01.00..C01.03 is not stated. Write 0 with explicit gains to make the configured gains authoritative.
